text:
maria: Quick sync — finalizing landing copy for the tri-mode pages (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private). Goal: single hero headline + 3 micro-CTAs, consistent benchmark claim for launch posts, and a short webinar follow-up. Any blockers?
jess: Like the goals. Hero idea A: "One inference platform — everywhere it matters" — feels a tad vague.
ranjit: Hero idea B: "Predictable production LLM inference — hosted, reserved, private" — more specific. Keep subhead to call out latency/cost.
elaine: Suggest subhead: "p95 latency under 200ms; predictable throughput and cost controls." Need eng to confirm numbers before we publish.
maria: Agreed. We should avoid absolute claims for Private (infra varies). Maybe: "Latency and cost tuned for production — typical hosted p95 shown in benchmarks."
ranjit: I'll pull the hosted/dedicated perf snapshots from the perf deck and a small table we can screenshot. ETA EOD. Note: Private will be annotated as "customer-dependent" with a link to deployment guide.
copybot: Draft CTAs: [Try Hosted] -> /signup, [Reserve Dedicated] -> /sales/reserve, [Request Private demo] -> /ae/request. Suggested microcopy under CTAs: "Start free trial • Book capacity • Request a private deployment review"
jess: For launch posts and benchmark narrative: lead with a short, reproducible benchmark (throughput @ 2k tokens/s, p95 latency). Then a 60s video showing failover and routing policies. Webinar idea: live benchmarking + Q&A on Apr 16.
elaine: Inbound routing: mark leads with tags: hosted-interest, dedicated-interest, private-interest. Private-interest -> AE queue immediately. Dedicated -> SDR nurture sequence. Also add UTM campaign=tri-launch for all links.
maria: Copy iteration plan: Jess to produce 3 hero variants (A/B/C) by EOD tomorrow, Copy to finalize microcopy + CTAs the day after, Ranjit to deliver verified numbers (1760000020). I'll sync with product for compliance phrasing.
ranjit: Confirmed I'll upload perf snippets and one-slide summary to drive.
jess: I'll prepare the A/B frames and short copy blurbs.
copybot: I'll push a draft landing copy file to /marketing/content/tri-mode-landing.md (draft) and add comments for legal-approved phrasing.
maria: Great. Reconvene tomorrow 10:00am to lock copy for staging. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
(automated) deploy-bot: note — staging branch for landing copy created: feature/tri-mode-landing
